_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Armor as it sits on the body: Armor as it sits on the body
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Card stays in the UI's place: Card stays in the UI's place
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Kept as is by another mod: Kept as is by another mod
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Let every follower be dressed again: Let every follower be dressed again
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Needed later for a quest at #: Needed later for a quest at #
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Needed later for a quest not begun y: Needed later for a quest not begun yet
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_No longer needed, its quest is done: No longer needed, its quest is done
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_No longer needed, its quest is over: No longer needed, its quest is over
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_No longer needed, the quest at # is: No longer needed, the quest at # is over
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Press a key, Esc keeps it, Delete cl: Press a key, Esc keeps it, Delete clears it
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Right click opens the item menu: Right click opens the item menu
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Right click, Esc or Tab to close: Right click, Esc or Tab to close
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Sold #, the merchant asks about the: Sold #, the merchant asks about the rest
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Still needed for a quest at #: Still needed for a quest at #
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Still needed, a quest asks for it: Still needed, a quest asks for it
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Still needed, a quest follows it: Still needed, a quest follows it
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_Zoom key opens the inspect view: Zoom key opens the inspect view
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help $IR_Let every follower be dress: A mod can ask the panel to leave a follower's gear as it is for a while, a quest's disguise say. If that mod is gone and a follower still can't be dressed in the panel, this lets every follower be dressed again.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help $IR_Show everything again: Every hidden slot and piece is shown on your character again.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bArmorPerWeight:Numbers: Armor rating for each unit of weight. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bArrows:List: A green arrow and +N or a red arrow and -N after the name of an item you could wear: how much more or less armor or damage it gives than what you wear in its place. Ammo only counts while a bow or crossbow is in your hands, a bow is weighed against a bow and a sword against a melee weapon.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bBadges:List: A row of something you could wear shows the sign of the slot it goes to.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bCompanionTabs:Panel: Tabs over your character: YOU and each follower near you, nearest first. A click in your inventory opens that follower's trade, a click in a trade opens another follower's or your own inventory. They show only when a follower is near enough to be loaded. Takes effect the next time the menu opens.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bCraftingMenu:Panel: Your character and your slots beside the list at a forge, a tanning rack, a workbench, a grindstone, an enchanter and the stations mods build on them. A right click on a piece of armor or a weapon tries it on for show, nothing is made or worn: the piece goes into its slot and on your character, and comes off by the same menu, by its slot or by trying another piece on the same slots. The companion tabs show a companion there to try pieces on them. All of it comes off as the menu closes. Takes effect the next time the menu opens. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bCritDamage:Numbers: The extra damage of a critical hit. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bDPM:Numbers: DPM, the same over a minute. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bDPS:Numbers: DPS, the damage of a weapon over a second of swings or shots. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bDoubleClickTakesOff:Slots: A double click on a slot takes off what you wear there.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bDragAndDrop:Slots: Drag a row of the list onto a slot or onto your character to put it on. A one handed weapon dropped on the left hand goes into the left hand.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bEffectiveHealth:Numbers: How much longer you last in a fight with the piece. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bEnabled:Panel: Off leaves the item menus of SkyUI exactly as they are and shows the pieces of hidden slots on your character while it stays off. The hidden slots are remembered and hide again when the panel is back on. Takes effect when the menu closes.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bEqualSign:List: An item that gives exactly what you wear gets a grey equals sign instead of nothing.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bEquipMotion:Doll: With a mod of equipping animations, Immersive Equipping Animations and the like, the character plays the animation as you put a piece on or take it off. Once the inventory closes your character in the world plays it too, as without the panel.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bFollowers:Panel: When you trade with a follower, the panel shows the follower: their doll, what they wear in the slots, and an item dragged into a slot goes on them. Works for any follower and any mod that opens a follower's inventory the game's way.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bHave:Lines: You have 3, under the numbers of what lies in a chest or a shop. One of the quiet tags. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bHeroStats:Window: A small tab at the feet of your character pulls your numbers up over it: level, health, magicka and stamina with how fast they come back, armor and resistances, swing time and damage a second of your weapon, speed, carry weight, what your gear weighs and how much of it slows you, sneak and power attacks, what enchantments and potions add to your skills, the spells in your hands, your bounties, and at the bottom the blessings, diseases and other effects on you. Click the tab or drag it as far as you like, the wheel scrolls. It stays out, the next time you open the menu too, until you push it back with the tab. Nothing is counted while it is in.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bHideIcons:Slots: A small eye in the corner of a slot hides what you wear there on your character, in the world too. It stays worn and keeps protecting you. The eye of a small slot in a strip hides that piece alone. Hidden slots and pieces are saved with your game.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bJunk:List: The menu of a row or the junk key marks an item as junk, every copy of it. In a shop one press sells all your junk, in a chest it stores it. What you wear, your favorites and anything a quest wants are never taken.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bKind:Lines: The kind under the item's name, like Heavy, Body. One of the quiet tags. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bLastAdded:List: The name column gets a LAST ADDED state: what you got last comes first.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bLeaveCard:Window: The card of an item stays where and as SkyUI or your UI skin draws it, with the mod's numbers in it and the item's model beside it, and no window comes over the rows; Details in a row's right-click menu still brings the window up. Where the card lies over your character (plain SkyUI) it shows the way the item does with the character switched off. Window pops up set to the UI's own card goes first. It comes with the next opening of the menu. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bMagicMenu:Panel: Your character in the magic menu between the slots of your two hands and your voice, with the spell, weapon or shout each one holds. A click on a slot narrows the list to what can go there, and a spell picked then goes into that hand. A double click on a hand takes a weapon, shield or torch off. Takes effect the next time the menu opens.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bModOrigin:Window: The quiet line From and the plugin's file under the numbers of an item a mod adds. Off hides just this line, the other quiet tags stay. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bModels:Slots: Each slot shows the model of what you wear there. Off shows flat signs.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bNewMarks:List: A small dot on what you got since you last closed the inventory, on its row and on its subcategory. It goes when the pointer passes the row or when the inventory closes.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bOnZoomKey:Inspect: The item zoom key of the game opens the full screen inspect view: drag to turn the item any way, the wheel brings it closer. Off leaves the game's own zoom.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bPieceStrips:Slots: A slot that holds more than one piece (a cloak, a bag and a lamp in Other, rings of several fingers) pulls out a strip of small slots when its tab is clicked: an empty one first that takes a dragged item, then one for every piece. Each can be opened, hidden, taken off or dropped on like a slot. Arrows and the wheel scroll a long strip, a click elsewhere, its handle or Esc put it back.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bPopup:Slots: A click on a slot opens the window of what you wear there beside the slot, and selects it in the list when the list shows it. The list keeps its category, subcategories and search. A click anywhere else closes the window. Off only selects the item, a slot whose item the list doesn't show still opens its window.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bQuestLine:Window: A line under the numbers of what a quest wants: which quest, and whether it still needs the item or is done with it. The arrowhead after the name of the row is Mark quest items on the List page. With both off the mod reads nothing of the quests. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bQuestMarks:List: A small arrowhead after the name of what a quest wants: gold while a quest still needs it, a dimmer gold when a quest that hasn't begun will, grey once its quest is done and you may let it go. The line of the item window that names the quest is Quest line on the Item window page. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bQuietTags:Window: The kind under the name, like Heavy, Body, and small grey lines under the numbers: how many you already have when it lies in a chest or a shop, silver, and the plugin it comes from when that is not the game itself. Quests have switches of their own, Quest line below and Mark quest items on the List page. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bReach:Numbers: How far a melee weapon reaches. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bRowMenu:List: A right click on a row opens a small menu: equip, equip in the left hand, use, favorite, inspect, and drop, take, store, buy or sell one, all or some. Off gives the right click back to the game, which equips in the left hand.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShow:Doll: Your character in 3D between the two columns of slots, with everything you wear.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowAmmo:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowAmulet:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowBody:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowFeet:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowHands:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowHead:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowLeft:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowOther:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowRight:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bShowRing:Slots: Off takes this slot off the panel, its place stays empty. What you wear there stays worn.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bSilver:Lines: Silver, under the numbers of a silver weapon. One of the quiet tags. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bSlotNumbers:Window: The window of anything you wear shows a small grey line with the body slots it takes, like Slots 32, 46. Handy with modular armor: pauldrons, belts and capes sit on slots 44 to 61, and two pieces on one slot push each other off. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStackWeight:List: The weight column gets SUMW states: the weight of a whole stack instead of one item.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStagger:Numbers: How hard a hit staggers. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStats:Window: Weapons show swing time, damage per second and per minute, reach, stagger and crit damage. Armor shows the share of a hit it stops, what the whole set stops and how much longer you last. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStillCamera:Panel: For mods that keep the world running while a menu is open, like Skyrim Souls RE. While the inventory is open, the pointer at an edge of the screen or a pushed stick no longer turns the camera behind the panel. Changes nothing when the game pauses in menus.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStolen:Lines: Stolen, or Stolen: 3 of 6, over the small lines. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStolenApart:List: Stolen copies of an item get a row of their own beside the ones that are yours, in your inventory and in chests, so you see what is stolen and store, take, sell or drop just those. A merchant's or a follower's things stay as they are. Needs game 1.6 or later.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bStops:Numbers: The share of a hit a piece of armor stops, or would stop in place of what you wear. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bSubcategories:List: A strip under the category icons. Weapons: one handed, two handed, bows, staves, ammo. Apparel: light, heavy, clothing, jewelry, shields, and a second group head, body, hands, feet, other; two groups add up. Potions: health, magicka, stamina, poisons. Food and drinks. Books, notes, maps, spell tomes. Ore, ingots, gems, soul gems, pelts.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bSwing:Numbers: How long a swing takes to land, or a bow to draw. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bWeightWarnings:List: In a chest or a shop the weight of a row turns red when taking one would slow you and amber when taking all of it would. The menu of a subcategory tells what it weighs.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bWholeSet:Numbers: What all you wear stops together, and the game's cap. Off hides just this line of the combat numbers. Also on the sliders sheet in the inventory, Item window page.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help bWornLook:Slots: Helmets, armor, gloves, boots, cloaks and jewelry are shown standing, the way they sit on you. Off shows the model the item has on the ground.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help fTurnSpeed:Doll: Drag across the character to turn it. Degrees it turns for every pixel the mouse moves.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iAccentColor:Look: The colour of what is picked, lit or counted: the frame of a chosen slot, lit buttons and eyes, tabs, headings of the character drawer and the numbers beside slot names. Gold by default, pick one that sits with your UI. Takes effect the next time you open the menu.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iJunkKey:List: Marks the row under the pointer as junk, or takes the mark off.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iNameText:Window: The item's name in the window, in percent of the size the card gives it. A name too long for its line at that size comes out as big as still fits.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iNumbersText:Window: The combat numbers under the card and the numbers in the card of a chest or a shop, in percent.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iPanelWidth:Panel: How wide the panel of slots and your character is, from the right edge of the screen. A narrower panel keeps further from the item list, for a UI skin or a screen where the slots lay over the rows. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar, where you see it change.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iPopUp:Window: When the item window with its card comes up over the row under the pointer. On hover: at once. After a pause: once the pointer rests on a row a moment, so moving over the list shows nothing. UI's own card: no window over the rows, the card and the model of a row stay where SkyUI or your UI skin puts them, as without this mod, for a skin whose card stands apart; with plain SkyUI that place is over your character. A switch to it or from it comes with the next opening of the menu. In any of them Details in a row's right-click menu brings the window up and keeps it until you pick another row, and a click on a slot opens its window. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iPose:Doll: Standing: the character always stands calm and straight, even when you open the menu on a horse, sitting or mid swing. As in the world: the pose of the moment you opened the menu, with only the head and spine turned straight. In first person the character stands either way, the body plays a stance made for the camera there.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iQuietText:Window: The kind under the name and the small lines under the numbers: the quest, the body slots, how many you have, silver, the mod an item comes from and Stolen, in percent.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iScale:Doll: The size of your character in percent of the size that fits between the slots. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar, where you see it change.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iShiftRight:Doll: Moves your character to the right of the middle of its room, below zero to the left, in percent of the room's width.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iShiftUp:Doll: Moves your character up from the middle of its room, below zero down, in percent of the room's height.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iSize:Window: The window of an item with its card, in percent. At 100 it takes about half the item list and never gets smaller than four tenths of the screen's height, so it reads on any screen. Make it bigger when the words of the card are too small for your screen, as on a TV across the room or a small handheld. It stops where the names of the rows would be covered. Also set in the inventory with the sliders button in the bottom bar.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iStackKey:List: In a container or a shop this key moves the whole stack of the row under the pointer at once, with no slider: take, store, buy or sell all of it.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iTextColor:Look: The colour of names, signs and buttons at rest. Pale parchment by default. Takes effect the next time you open the menu.
line:mod_interface_translation/inventory.$IR_help iWordsText:Window: What a potion, an enchantment, a book or a spell does, as the card writes it, in percent. The card grows down and the numbers under it make room.
